import { Controller, Get, Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { CACHE_MANAGER } from '@nestjs/cache-manager';
import type { Cache } from 'cache-manager';
import Redis from 'ioredis';
import { OnEvent } from '@nestjs/event-emitter';

const EXACT_CACHE_KEY = 'cache:exact';

@Injectable()
export class ResourceService {
  private readonly cachePrefix: string;

  constructor(
    @Inject(CACHE_MANAGER) private readonly cache: Cache,
    private readonly redis: Redis,
  ) {
    this.cachePrefix = 'runtime-prefix';
  }

  async useResources(id: string, dynamicKey: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.cache.get(EXACT_CACHE_KEY);
    await this.cache.set(`user:${id}`, { secretPayload: dynamicKey });
    await this.cache.del(this.cachePrefix);
    await this.cache.wrap(dynamicKey, async () => 'payload-not-retained');

    await this.redis.get('redis:exact');
    await this.redis.get('');
    await this.redis.set(`redis:${id}`, dynamicKey);
    await this.redis.hgetall('profile:hash');
    await this.redis.hset(`profile:${id}`, 'token', dynamicKey);
    await this.redis.del('redis:a', 'redis:b');
    await this.redis.expire('redis:a', 60);
    await this.redis.scan('0', 'MATCH', 'redis:*', 'COUNT', 50);
    await this.redis.hscan(`profile:${id}`, '0', 'MATCH', 'field:*');

    this.redis.pipeline();
    await this.redis.publish('events', dynamicKey);
    await this.redis.keys('*');
  }

  @OnEvent('cache.warm')
  async warmCache(): Promise<void> {
    await this.cache.set('cache:warm', 'handler-payload-not-retained');
  }
}

@Controller('resources')
export class ResourceController {
  constructor(private readonly resources: ResourceService) {}

  @Get(':id')
  async read(): Promise<void> {
    await this.resources.useResources('id', 'runtime');
  }
}

class CacheLookalike {
  get(_key: string): void {}
}

@Injectable()
export class LookalikeService {
  constructor(private readonly cache: CacheLookalike) {}
  ignored(): void {
    this.cache.get('lookalike');
  }
}
